records.subject: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
records.body:
Hi Isla,

It's been a few days -- how's the setup going on your end? If you'd like a short walkthrough call, I'm happy to set one up.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Looking to get more out of Wrenfield? Inviting your teammates is the single biggest thing that makes it click.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Clearwater Logistics set up
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Welcome to Wrenfield -- excited to have Clearwater Logistics here. If you get stuck on anything in the first few days, just reply to this email directly and it'll come straight to me.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Account created first project on day 3 (as_of facts), showing real activity, but no invite sent and no reply to three Wrenfield emails (email:95aaf102, email:49d5439f, email:a90dbc20). No tickets, so no visible blocker. Pro plan plus 8 days left leaves moderate chance of self-serve activation.

draft.subject: Next step for Clearwater Logistics in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Nice work getting your first project created in Wrenfield -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that's the right foundation.

The usual next step is bringing someone else in: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

If it's helpful, I'd be glad to walk through that first invite with you on a short call this week -- just reply with a time that suits you.

Best,
Nadia
